reterraforged.mudSwamps.metadata.descrip.en: Changes the swamp material to mud
reterraforged.mudSwamps.metadata.descrip.zh: 将沼泽地材料改为泥巴

reterraforged.gui.button.oreCompatibleSt.zh: 仅与矿石兼容的石头类型

reterraforged.gui.button.continentType.t.zh: 控制大陆生成器的类型

reterraforged.gui.button.continentShape..en: Controls how continent shapes are calculated. You may also need to adjust the transition points to ensure beaches etc still form.
reterraforged.gui.button.continentShape..zh: 控制大陆形状的计算方式。你可能还需要调整过渡点，以确保海滩等地形能够形成。

reterraforged.gui.button.spawnType.toolt.en: Set whether spawn should be close to x=0,z=0 or the centre of the nearest continent
reterraforged.gui.button.spawnType.toolt.zh: 设置出生点应该位于x=0,z=0附近还是最近大陆的中心

reterraforged.gui.button.largeOreVeins.t.en: Set whether large ore veins spawn
reterraforged.gui.button.largeOreVeins.t.zh: 设置是否生成大型矿脉

reterraforged.gui.button.legacyCarverDis.zh: 设置是否使用1.16版本的开凿分布

reterraforged.gui.button.climateSeedOffs.en: A seed offset used to randomise climate distribution
reterraforged.gui.button.climateSeedOffs.zh: 用于随机化气候分布的种子偏移

reterraforged.gui.button.terrainSeedOffs.en: A seed offset used to randomise terrain distribution
reterraforged.gui.button.terrainSeedOffs.zh: 用于随机化地形分布的种子偏移

reterraforged.gui.button.fancyMountains..en: Carries out extra processing on mountains to make them look even nicer. Can be disabled to improve performance slightly.
reterraforged.gui.button.fancyMountains..zh: 对山脉进行额外处理，使其看起来更加漂亮。可以禁用以略微提高性能。

reterraforged.gui.button.riverSeedOffset.en: A seed offset used to randomise river distribution
reterraforged.gui.button.riverSeedOffset.zh: 用于随机化河流分布的种子偏移

reterraforged.gui.button.salt.tooltip.en: A random seed value for the structure.

reterraforged.gui.button.smoothLayerDeco.en: Modifies layer block levels (ie snow) to fit the terrain
reterraforged.gui.button.smoothLayerDeco.zh: 修改层级方块的高度（比如雪）来适配地形

reterraforged.gui.button.strataDecorator.en: Generates strata (rock layers) instead of just stone
reterraforged.gui.button.strataDecorator.zh: 生成地层（岩层）而不仅仅是石头

reterraforged.gui.button.oreCompatibleSt.en: Only use stone types that ores can generate in
reterraforged.gui.button.oreCompatibleSt.zh: 仅使用可以生成矿石的石头类型

reterraforged.gui.button.erosionDecorato.en: Replace surface materials where erosion has occurred
reterraforged.gui.button.erosionDecorato.zh: 在侵蚀发生处替换表层材料

reterraforged.gui.button.stoneErosion.to.en: Changes most exposed rock surfaces to plain stone
reterraforged.gui.button.stoneErosion.to.zh: 将大部分裸露的岩石表面变为普通石头

reterraforged.gui.button.naturalSnowDeco.en: Removes snow from the terrain where it shouldn't naturally settle
reterraforged.gui.button.naturalSnowDeco.zh: 从不自然堆积的地形中移除雪

reterraforged.gui.button.customBiomeFeat.en: Use custom biome features in place of vanilla ones (such as trees)
reterraforged.gui.button.customBiomeFeat.zh: 使用自定义的生物群系特征代替原版的（如树木）

reterraforged.gui.button.vanillaSprings..en: Allow vanilla springs (water source blocks) to generate

reterraforged.gui.button.vanillaLavaSpri.en: Allow vanilla springs (lava source blocks) to generate
reterraforged.gui.button.vanillaLavaSpri.zh: 允许生成原版熔岩源泉

reterraforged.gui.slider.zoom.tooltip.en: Controls the zoom level of the preview map
reterraforged.gui.slider.zoom.tooltip.zh: 控制预览图的缩放级别

reterraforged.gui.slider.continentScale..en: Controls the size of continents. You may also need to adjust the transition points to ensure beaches etc still form.
reterraforged.gui.slider.continentScale..zh: 控制大陆的大小。您可能还需要调整过渡点以确保海滩等地形仍能形成。

reterraforged.gui.slider.continentJitter.en: Controls how much continent centers are offset from the underlying noise grid.
reterraforged.gui.slider.continentJitter.zh: 控制大陆中心相对于底层噪声网格的偏移量。

reterraforged.gui.slider.continentSkippi.en: Reduces the number of continents to create more vast oceans.
reterraforged.gui.slider.continentSkippi.zh: 减少大陆的数量，以创建更广阔的海洋。

reterraforged.gui.slider.continentSizeVa.en: Increases the variance of continent sizes.
reterraforged.gui.slider.continentSizeVa.zh: 增加大陆大小的变异性。

reterraforged.gui.slider.continentNoiseO.en: The number of octaves of noise used to distort the continent.
reterraforged.gui.slider.continentNoiseO.zh: 用于扰乱大陆的噪声倍频数量。

reterraforged.gui.slider.continentNoiseG.en: The contribution strength of each noise octave.
reterraforged.gui.slider.continentNoiseG.zh: 每个噪声倍频的贡献强度。

reterraforged.gui.slider.continentNoisLa.en: The frequency multiplier for each noise octave.

reterraforged.gui.slider.mushroomFieldsI.en: Controls the point below which mushroom fields coasts transition into mushroom fields. The greater the gap to the mushroom fields coasts slider, the more gradual the transition.

reterraforged.gui.slider.mushroomFieldsC.en: Controls the point below which deep oceans transition into mushroom fields coasts. The greater the gap to the deep ocean slider, the more gradual the transition.

reterraforged.gui.slider.deepOcean.toolt.en: Controls the point above which deep oceans transition into shallow oceans. The greater the gap to the shallow ocean slider, the more gradual the transition.
reterraforged.gui.slider.deepOcean.toolt.zh: 控制深海过渡成浅海的点。与浅海滑杆的间距越大，过渡越渐进。

reterraforged.gui.slider.shallowOcean.to.en: Controls the point above which shallow oceans transition into coastal terrain. The greater the gap to the coast slider, the more gradual the transition.
reterraforged.gui.slider.shallowOcean.to.zh: 控制浅海过渡到沿海地形的高度。与海岸滑杆间隙越大，过渡越渐进。

reterraforged.gui.slider.beach.tooltip.en: Controls how much of the coastal terrain is assigned to beach biomes.
reterraforged.gui.slider.beach.tooltip.zh: 控制沿海地形的海滩生物群系分配比例。

reterraforged.gui.slider.coast.tooltip.en: Controls the size of coastal regions and is also the point below which inland terrain transitions into oceans. Certain biomes such as Mushroom Fields only generate in coastal areas.
reterraforged.gui.slider.coast.tooltip.zh: 控制海岸地区的大小，同时也是内陆地形过渡成海洋的点。

reterraforged.gui.slider.inland.tooltip.en: Controls the overall transition from ocean to inland terrain.
reterraforged.gui.slider.inland.tooltip.zh: 控制从海洋到内陆地形的整体过渡。

reterraforged.gui.slider.entranceCavePro.en: Controls the probability that an entrance cave will generate
reterraforged.gui.slider.entranceCavePro.zh: 控制生成入口洞穴的概率

reterraforged.gui.slider.cheeseCaveDepth.en: Controls the depth at which cheese caves start to generate
reterraforged.gui.slider.cheeseCaveDepth.zh: 控制奶酪洞穴开始生成的深度

reterraforged.gui.slider.cheeseCaveProba.en: Controls probability that a cheese cave will generate
reterraforged.gui.slider.cheeseCaveProba.zh: 控制生成奶酪洞穴的概率

reterraforged.gui.slider.spaghettiCavePr.en: Controls the probability that a spaghetti cave will generate
reterraforged.gui.slider.spaghettiCavePr.zh: 控制生成细管洞穴的几率

reterraforged.gui.slider.noodleCaveProba.en: Controls probability that a noodle cave will generate
reterraforged.gui.slider.noodleCaveProba.zh: 控制生成细洞穴的概率

reterraforged.gui.slider.carverCaveProba.en: Controls the probability that a cave carver will generate
reterraforged.gui.slider.carverCaveProba.zh: 控制洞穴开凿器生成的概率

reterraforged.gui.slider.deepCarverCaveP.en: Controls the probability that a deep cave carver will generate
reterraforged.gui.slider.deepCarverCaveP.zh: 控制深层洞穴开凿将生成的概率

reterraforged.gui.slider.ravineProbabili.en: Controls the probability that a ravine carver will generate

reterraforged.gui.slider.temperatureFall.en: How quickly values transition from an extremity
reterraforged.gui.slider.temperatureFall.zh: 温度值从极端过渡到正常的速率

reterraforged.gui.slider.temperatureMin..en: The lower limit of the range

reterraforged.gui.slider.temperatureMax..en: The upper limit of the range

reterraforged.gui.slider.temperatureBias.en: The bias towards either end of the range
reterraforged.gui.slider.temperatureBias.zh: 偏向范围两端的温度偏差

reterraforged.gui.slider.moistureFalloff.en: How quickly values transition from an extremity
reterraforged.gui.slider.moistureFalloff.zh: 值从极端过渡到中间的速率

reterraforged.gui.slider.moistureMin.too.en: The lower limit of the range

reterraforged.gui.slider.moistureMax.too.en: The upper limit of the range

reterraforged.gui.slider.moistureBias.to.en: The bias towards either end of the range

reterraforged.gui.slider.biomeSize.toolt.en: Controls the size of individual biomes
reterraforged.gui.slider.biomeSize.toolt.zh: 控制各个生物群系的大小

reterraforged.gui.slider.macroNoiseSize..en: Macro noise is used to group large areas of biomes into a single type (such as deserts)
reterraforged.gui.slider.macroNoiseSize..zh: 宏观噪声用于将大片生物群落分组为同一类型（比如沙漠）

reterraforged.gui.slider.biomeWarpScale..en: Controls the scale of shape distortion for biomes
reterraforged.gui.slider.biomeWarpScale..zh: 控制生物群系形状畸变的比例

reterraforged.gui.slider.biomeWarpStreng.en: Controls the strength of shape distortion for biomes
reterraforged.gui.slider.biomeWarpStreng.zh: 控制生物群系形状畸变的强度

reterraforged.gui.slider.biomeEdgeScale..en: Controls the scale of the noise

reterraforged.gui.slider.biomeEdgeOctave.en: Controls the number of noise octaves

reterraforged.gui.slider.biomeEdgeGain.t.en: Controls the gain subsequent noise octaves
reterraforged.gui.slider.biomeEdgeGain.t.zh: 控制后续噪音倍频的增益

reterraforged.gui.slider.biomeEdgeLacuna.en: Controls the lacunarity of subsequent noise octaves
reterraforged.gui.slider.biomeEdgeLacuna.zh: 控制后续噪音倍频的孔隙度

reterraforged.gui.slider.biomeEdgeStreng.en: Controls the strength of the noise

reterraforged.gui.slider.terrainRegionSi.en: Controls the size of terrain regions

reterraforged.gui.slider.globalVerticalS.en: Globally controls the vertical scaling of terrain
reterraforged.gui.slider.globalVerticalS.zh: 全局控制地形的垂直缩放

reterraforged.gui.slider.globalHorizonta.en: Globally controls the horizontal scaling of terrain
reterraforged.gui.slider.globalHorizonta.zh: 全局控制地形的水平缩放

reterraforged.gui.slider.terrain.weight..en: Controls how common this terrain type is
reterraforged.gui.slider.terrain.weight..zh: 控制该地形类型的常见程度

reterraforged.gui.slider.terrain.baseSca.en: Controls the base height of this terrain
reterraforged.gui.slider.terrain.baseSca.zh: 控制此地形的基础高度

reterraforged.gui.slider.terrain.vertica.en: Stretches or compresses the terrain vertically

reterraforged.gui.slider.terrain.horizon.en: Stretches or compresses the terrain horizontally

reterraforged.gui.slider.riverCount.tool.en: Controls the number of main rivers per continent.
reterraforged.gui.slider.riverCount.tool.zh: 控制每块大陆上主要河流的数量。

reterraforged.gui.slider.river.bedDepth..en: Controls the depth of the river

reterraforged.gui.slider.river.minBankHe.en: Controls the height of river banks

reterraforged.gui.slider.river.maxBankHe.en: Controls the height of river banks

reterraforged.gui.slider.lake.chance.too.en: Controls the chance of a lake spawning

reterraforged.gui.slider.lake.minStartDi.en: The minimum distance along a river that a lake will spawn
reterraforged.gui.slider.lake.minStartDi.zh: 湖泊在河流沿线生成的最小距离

reterraforged.gui.slider.lake.maxStartDi.en: The maximum distance along a river that a lake will spawn
reterraforged.gui.slider.lake.maxStartDi.zh: 湖泊在河流沿线生成的最大距离

reterraforged.gui.slider.lake.depth.tool.en: The max depth of the lake

reterraforged.gui.slider.lake.sizeMin.to.en: The minimum size of the lake

reterraforged.gui.slider.lake.sizeMax.to.en: The maximum size of the lake

reterraforged.gui.slider.wetland.sizeMin.en: The minimum size of the wetlands

reterraforged.gui.slider.wetland.sizeMax.en: The maximum size of the wetlands

reterraforged.gui.slider.erosion.droplet.en: The average number of water droplets to simulate per chunk
reterraforged.gui.slider.erosion.droplet.zh: 每块地区模拟的平均水滴数

reterraforged.gui.slider.erosion.droplet.en: Controls the number of iterations that a single water droplet is simulated for
reterraforged.gui.slider.erosion.droplet.zh: 控制单个水滴模拟迭代的次数

reterraforged.gui.slider.erosion.droplet.en: Controls the starting volume of water that a simulated water droplet carries
reterraforged.gui.slider.erosion.droplet.zh: 控制模拟水滴携带的起始水量

reterraforged.gui.slider.erosion.droplet.en: Controls the starting velocity of the simulated water droplet
reterraforged.gui.slider.erosion.droplet.zh: 控制模拟水滴的起始速度

reterraforged.gui.slider.erosion.rate.to.en: Controls how quickly material dissolves (during erosion)
reterraforged.gui.slider.erosion.rate.to.zh: 控制物质溶解的速率（在侵蚀过程中）

reterraforged.gui.slider.erosion.deposit.en: Controls how quickly material is deposited (during erosion)
reterraforged.gui.slider.erosion.deposit.zh: 控制物质沉积的速率（在侵蚀过程中）

reterraforged.gui.slider.smoothing.itera.en: Controls the number of smoothing iterations
reterraforged.gui.slider.smoothing.itera.zh: 控制平滑处理的迭代次数

reterraforged.gui.slider.smoothing.rate..en: Controls how strongly smoothing is applied

reterraforged.gui.slider.spacing.tooltip.en: Controls the size of the grid used to generate the structure. Structures will attempt to generate once per grid cell. Larger spacing values will make the structure appear less frequently.
reterraforged.gui.slider.spacing.tooltip.zh: 控制用于生成结构的网格大小。结构将尝试在每个网格单元生成一次。更大的间距值会让结构出现得更少。

reterraforged.gui.slider.separation.tool.en: Controls the minimum distance between instances of the structure. Larger values guarantee larger distances between structures of the same type but cause them to generate more 'grid-aligned'. Lower values will produce a more random distribution but may allow instances to generate closer together.
reterraforged.gui.slider.separation.tool.zh: 控制同类结构之间的最小距离。较大的值会保证结构之间有较大的距离，但可能会导致它们更加对齐网格。较小的值可能会让分布更随机，但允许结构更近地生成。

reterraforged.gui.slider.mountainBiomeUs.en:
The probability that mountainous terrain will be set to a mountain biome type.
This may help improve compatibility with mods that rely exclusively on mountain biomes.
reterraforged.gui.slider.mountainBiomeUs.zh:
山地地形被设置为山地生物群系类型的概率。
这有助于提高与只依赖山地生物群系的模组的兼容性。

reterraforged.gui.slider.volcanoBiomeUsa.en:
The probability that volcano terrain will be set to a volcano biome type.
This may help improve compatibility with mods that rely exclusively on volcano biomes.
reterraforged.gui.slider.volcanoBiomeUsa.zh:
火山地形被设置为火山生物群系类型的概率。
这有助于提高与只依赖火山生物群系的模组的兼容性。

reterraforged.gui.slider.strataRegionSiz.en: Controls the size of strata regions

reterraforged.gui.button.legacyMountainS.zh: 将山脉的缩放更改为与传统的TerraForged兼容

reterraforged.gui.slider.continentNoiseL.zh: 每个噪声倍频的频率倍数。

reterraforged.gui.slider.dirtMin.tooltip.zh: 控制表面可以过渡成尘土的最低y级别

reterraforged.gui.slider.dirtSteepness.t.zh: 控制表面可以过渡成尘土的陡度

reterraforged.gui.slider.islandCoast.too.zh: 控制深海过渡到岛屿海岸的点。与深海滑块的间距越大，过渡越渐进。

reterraforged.gui.slider.islandInland.to.zh: 控制岛屿海岸过渡到岛屿内陆的点。与岛屿海岸滑杆的间距越大，过渡越渐进。

reterraforged.gui.slider.rockMin.tooltip.zh: 控制表面可以过渡成岩石的最低y级别

reterraforged.gui.slider.rockSteepness.t.zh: 表面可以过渡成岩石的陡度

reterraforged.gui.slider.screeSteepness..zh: 表面可以过渡成碎石的陡度
